About me

A little more about who I am

I’m a UI/UX designer and front-end developer in training, building my skills through formal education and hands-on projects. I design clean, intuitive interfaces in Figma and turn them into responsive web pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Daydream Studio is my creative practice, where branding, layout and interface design come together. I care about clear visual hierarchy, consistent systems and interfaces that are easy to use.
